CREATE TABLE hvlstajproject.patient ( id bigint generated by default as identity,
tc_no varchar(11) not null, first_name varchar(50) not null, last_name varchar(50) not null, email varchar(100) not null, birth_date date not null, tel_no varchar(13) not null, address varchar(255) not null, gender varchar(10) not null,
constraint pk_patient primary key (id),
constraint uk_patient_tc_no unique (tc_no),
constraint uk_patient_email unique (email),
constraint uk_patient_tel_no unique (tel_no),
constraint chk_patient_tel_no_format check (tel_no ~ '^[+]905[0-9]{9}$') );
